choices.label: Ask the scientist to reconsider the hypothesis.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The survey documents several rare ordinary animals.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A blurry silhouette excites the village but proves nothing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The scientist publishes an honest account of uncertain evidence.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The scientist feels humiliated and withdraws from the project.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The scientist returns empty-handed and wiser.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The scientist never returns, and the village searches without learning what happened.
